name: Blockstream Satellite API
description: RESTful API and transmitter daemon for the Blockstream Satellite network, enabling global message broadcast via satellite with Bitcoin Lightning payments. Full docker-compose orchestration.

docker_support.docker_evidence: docker-compose.yml launches API server, transmitter daemon, Bitcoin Lightning Charge, and Redis with a single docker-compose up command.

eval_notes: Satellite messaging API with payment integration. Agents could manage message transmission queues, troubleshoot payment processing, and optimize satellite broadcast scheduling.
